name: Angel Tear: Goddess Betrayed
storyline:
One fateful night, Yuri Maishima awakens her latent power to transform into the magical girl Angel Tear. Alongside her partner, Holy Rouge, she fights against the Demon God and his minions, protecting innocent people from harm. However, evil energy is seeping through the Demon Realm, corrupting the people she's supposed to protect! To make matters worse, others plot against her from the shadows, intent on using Angel Tear for their own gain.

Time is running out before all of humanity succumbs to demons' corruption. Can Yuri master her powers, keep her true identity a secret, and save the world? Or will she fall into the hands of evil? Uncover her fate!
summary: As the evil Demon God's power grows in strength, all hope seems lost. However, one day, Yuri Maishima, finds herself transforming into the powerful Angel Tear. Can she master her powers to counter this evil?
